localBiteReport: The most recent available reports (from guides active on Choctawhatchee Bay in early-to-mid October 2026) point to a solid fall inshore bite with redfish leading the action. Half Hitch's Destin report from late September noted redfish dominating the bay bite, trout active around dock lights after dark, and flounder gigging ramping up — all trends that typically strengthen into October.
